name: sql_database

args.query:
CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS
SELECT 
    cohort,
    COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
    (SELECT contact_note 
     FROM (SELECT contact_notes AS contact_note 
           FROM participants
           WHERE participants.cohort = cohorts.cohort
           LIMIT 1)) AS example_comment
FROM participants
GROUP BY cohort;
